seo.title: Your Company — cleaning in Tashkent: flats and offices
seo.description: Deep and regular cleaning, post-renovation cleaning, window washing and upholstery cleaning. Our own supplies and equipment, fixed prices, same-day visits.
seo.answer: Your Company cleans flats, houses and offices in Tashkent every day from 8:00 to 21:00. A regular clean of a flat up to 60 m² is 450,000 UZS, a deep clean from 900,000 UZS, a post-renovation clean from 1,500,000 UZS and window washing from 40,000 UZS per pane. We bring our own supplies and equipment and fix the price before we come.

sections.title: Clean as day one
sections.subtitle: We clean your flat, house or office with our own supplies and equipment. You get the price before we come, and if anything isn’t right, we redo it for free.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: What we clean
sections.intro: Prices are for flats up to 60 m². Larger spaces are priced by area.

items.title: Regular clean
items.text: Dust, floors, kitchen and bathroom — fresh every week.

items.title: Deep clean
items.text: Everything, including inside cupboards, tiles, appliances and skirting.

items.title: Post-renovation
items.text: Construction dust, paint and grout marks, window washing.

items.title: Window washing
items.text: Glass, frames and sills on both sides.

items.title: Upholstery cleaning
items.text: Sofas, armchairs and mattresses with an extractor; dry in 4–6 hours.

items.title: Offices
items.text: Daily or evening cleaning under contract.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Our own people, our own supplies
sections.text: Our cleaners are on staff, trained and vetted. We use professional products that are safe for children and pets, and keep separate cloths for the kitchen and bathroom so dirt never travels.

items.title: Request
items.text: Tell us the size and what you need — we quote a price.

items.title: Arrival
items.text: We arrive at your chosen time with everything needed.

items.title: Cleaning
items.text: We follow a checklist room by room.

items.title: Walk-through
items.text: We walk through together and fix anything on the spot.

items.label: free redo if you’re not happy

items.quote: After the renovation I thought the dust would stay forever. The crew handled it in a day.
items.author: Gulnora

items.quote: The same cleaner comes every time and knows where everything goes. You get home and it just feels good.
items.author: Rustam

items.quote: They cleaned the sofa after our cat — no stains and no smell.
items.author: Anna

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: No. Leave the keys with the concierge or let the cleaner in and head out — we’ll do the walk-through by photo.

items.q: Are the products safe for children?
items.a: Yes, we use professional products without harsh smells. If anyone has allergies, tell us and we’ll bring hypoallergenic ones.

items.q: What does a deep clean include?
items.a: Everything in a regular clean plus inside cupboards, appliances, tiles, doors, skirting and radiators.
Cash or transfer after the walk-through. Offices pay by invoice.
Yes, free of charge with 12 hours’ notice.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Book a clean today
sections.text: Send the size and address and we’ll reply with a price and the next free slot.
